# Super Soldier Project

> > A tactical fitness platform combining combat sports training, functional strength workouts, and military-inspired conditioning programs.

Super Soldier Project delivers no-excuses fitness training through kettlebell workouts, MMA conditioning, character-inspired circuits (like Deathstroke), and martial arts philosophy. Founded by Martin Gallagher, the site emphasizes Areté (pursuing excellence) with practical guides for strength, nutrition, and combat sports.

## Key Topics

- Super Soldier Project
- EMOM (Every Minute on the Minute)
- AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible)
- TABATA
- MMA Training
- Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu
- Kettlebell Training
- Functional Fitness
- Combat Sports
- Strength Training
- Cardiovascular Fitness
- Fitness Nutrition
- Character-Inspired Workouts
- Martial Arts Philosophy
- UFC

## Training Guides & Progressions

- [Workout Compendium/workoutsexplained/supersoldierproject](https://supersoldierproject.com/super-soldier-workouts): Guide to workout types: EMOM, AMRAP, TABATA, Circuit Training explained
- [Ground Zero — A Guide for New and Returning Runners](https://supersoldierproject.com/ground-zero-a-guide-for-new-and-returning-runners): Beginner running guide with 4-week plan and injury prevention tips
- [From Zero to Your First Pull-Up: A Practical Progression Plan](https://supersoldierproject.com/from-zero-to-your-first-pull-up-a-practical-progression-plan): Step-by-step pull-up progression from rows to strict pull-ups
- [TGU Workshop - Super Soldier Project](https://supersoldierproject.com/turkish-get-up/tgu-workshop): Turkish Get-Up kettlebell workshop: step-by-step movement breakdown

## Nutrition & Recovery

- [Calculating Your Energy Needs Made Simple](https://supersoldierproject.com/calculating-your-energy-needs-made-simple): BMR, PAL, and calorie calculation guide for weight management
- [The Complete Guide to Training Supplements](https://supersoldierproject.com/the-complete-guide-to-training-supplements): Training supplements guide: protein, creatine, timing, and combinations
- [Meal Planning and Prepping For Fitness](https://supersoldierproject.com/meal-planning-and-prepping-for-fitness): Fitness meal planning strategies: portion control and macronutrients
- [Size Matters - Portion Control in Nutrition](https://supersoldierproject.com/size-matters-portion-control-in-nutrition): Portion control guide for fitness nutrition and weight management
- [Resting the injured ankle. - Super Soldier Project](https://supersoldierproject.com/injury-prevention-and-treatment/rest): PRICE protocol guide for ankle injury treatment and prevention

## Combat Sports & MMA

- [The Rise of MMA](https://supersoldierproject.com/the-rise-of-mma): MMA evolution from UFC 1 and Royce Gracie to modern global phenomenon
- [The Road to MMA](https://supersoldierproject.com/the-road-to-mma): MMA origins: Vale Tudo, BJJ, Bruce Lee, and UFC's birth
- [Combat Sambo - The Beast from the East](https://supersoldierproject.com/combat-sambo-the-beast-from-the-east): Russian Combat Sambo history, origins, and Soviet Red Army development
- [Arnis – Filipino Martial Arts for the Real World](https://supersoldierproject.com/arnis-filipino-martial-arts): Filipino martial art Arnis/Eskrima: stick, blade, and combat training
- [Alex Pereira MMA Conditioning](https://supersoldierproject.com/alex-pereira-mma-conditioning): UFC Light-Heavyweight Champion Alex Pereira's MMA conditioning drills
